# Clean Architecture for Gemini CLI

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/clean-architecture/ in the guided-plugins repository.

Install from a checkout of the repository (Gemini installs one extension per repository from GitHub, so use the local path):

```bash
gemini extensions install ./dist/gemini/clean-architecture
```

Gemini asks you to confirm before it installs (trust and consent prompts).

- 38 skills (including 6 mode skills). Gemini's documentation says each is also a slash command `/clean-architecture:clean-architecture-<name>`; that was not exercised in a live session here.
- 22 subagents, started with `@clean-architecture-<name> <task>`.
